correctness.rationale: All possible five-symbol permutations (120) and one-deletion outputs (24) are enumerated exactly. A code is valid iff all 24-bit descendant masks are pairwise disjoint. Every increasing-index eight-set is considered, yielding precisely 1,568 valid sets; exhaustive nine-set search yields zero and therefore excludes every larger code. An explicit eight-word construction attains the upper bound. Two independent standard-language implementations replay the 1,568 and zero counts. A separate complete symmetry action on each optimizer gives orbit sizes 1:2, 2:1, 4:43, 8:174, totaling exactly 220 classes, and the complete canonical-representative CSV is recomputed and checked. The result is finite and is not extrapolated to any other length.

value.rationale: Rank-modulation storage gives a motivated natural 120-state, 24-output finite channel whose exact optimal codebook structure matters. At five cells the classic double-signature method attains the eight-word ceiling but provides only one of 1,568 maximizers; classifying all 220 natural symmetry classes, including 36 optimal codes omitting both monotone permutations, is a complete natural equality census and a meaningful fixed-block design benchmark. It does not claim improvements for other lengths.
